description: Workflow jobs that run without in-job resource sampling. Their timings are still collected from the Actions API by scripts/ci/collect-run.mjs; only the CPU/memory/disk/network series are absent. `npm run ci:telemetry-coverage -- --check` fails on any job missing the sampler that is not listed here.

jobs.ci-telemetry.yml#collect: The collector. Measuring the measurement would add a run to the store on every run of the store's own writer.
jobs.ci.yml#simulation-replay-compare: Consumes artifacts from simulation-replay and never checks out the repository, so the sampler is not on disk.
jobs.pages.yml#deploy: Calls actions/deploy-pages and nothing else; there is no checkout and no workload to sample.
jobs.pages.yml#freshness: A single github-script call comparing SHAs; no checkout, and nothing to measure.
